title: The Sin of Partiality, Faith Without Works Is Dead

questions.question: My brothers, show no ____ as you hold the faith in our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory.
questions.explanation: James 2:1 (ESV): "My brothers, show no partiality as you hold the faith in our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory."

questions.question: For if a man wearing a ____ ring and fine clothing comes into your assembly, and a poor man in shabby clothing also comes in,
questions.explanation: James 2:2 (ESV): "For if a man wearing a gold ring and fine clothing comes into your assembly, and a poor man in shabby clothing also comes in,"

questions.question: and if you pay attention to the one who wears the fine clothing and say, "You sit here in a good place," while you say to the poor man, "You stand over there," or, "Sit down at my ____,"
questions.explanation: James 2:3 (ESV): "and if you pay attention to the one who wears the fine clothing and say, 'You sit here in a good place,' while you say to the poor man, 'You stand over there,' or, 'Sit down at my feet,'"

questions.question: Listen, my beloved brothers, has not God chosen those who are poor in the world to be rich in ____ and heirs of the kingdom,
questions.explanation: James 2:5 (ESV): "Listen, my beloved brothers, has not God chosen those who are poor in the world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom, which he has promised to those who love him?"

questions.question: Are not the rich the ones who oppress you, and the ones who drag you into ____?
questions.explanation: James 2:6 (ESV): "But you have dishonored the poor man. Are not the rich the ones who oppress you, and the ones who drag you into court?"

questions.question: If you really fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall ____ your neighbor as yourself," you are doing well.
questions.explanation: James 2:8 (ESV): "If you really fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself,' you are doing well."

questions.question: But if you show partiality, you are committing ____ and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
questions.explanation: James 2:9 (ESV): "But if you show partiality, you are committing sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors."

questions.question: For whoever keeps the whole law but fails in ____ point has become guilty of all of it.
questions.explanation: James 2:10 (ESV): "For whoever keeps the whole law but fails in one point has become guilty of all of it."

questions.question: For judgment is without mercy to one who has shown no mercy. ____ triumphs over judgment.
questions.explanation: James 2:13 (ESV): "For judgment is without mercy to one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment."

questions.question: What good is it, my brothers, if someone says he has faith but does not have ____? Can that faith save him?
questions.explanation: James 2:14 (ESV): "What good is it, my brothers, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can that faith save him?"

questions.question: If a brother or sister is poorly clothed and lacking in daily ____,
questions.explanation: James 2:15 (ESV): "If a brother or sister is poorly clothed and lacking in daily food,"

questions.question: and one of you says to them, "Go in peace, be warmed and filled," without giving them the things needed for the body, what ____ is that?
questions.explanation: James 2:16 (ESV): "and one of you says to them, 'Go in peace, be warmed and filled,' without giving them the things needed for the body, what good is that?"

questions.question: So also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is ____.
questions.explanation: James 2:17 (ESV): "So also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead."

questions.question: You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the ____ believe—and shudder!
questions.explanation: James 2:19 (ESV): "You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the demons believe—and shudder!"

questions.question: Was not ____ our father justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar?
questions.explanation: James 2:21 (ESV): "Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar?"

key_verse_text: So also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead.
